author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the announcement trailer for War Fantasy, a psychological horror FPS game developed by Non-Euclidean. You will face a demented commanding officer who controls your every move, and the line between war simulation and real war dissolves into impossible, stunning spaces. You are not a soldier. You are being made into one. War Fantasy is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: War Fantasy - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the latest 9 Kings trailer for this fast-paced roguelike kingdom builder game to see what to expect with the Multiplayer Update. In 9 Kings, grow your empire and fight massive battles against powerful rival kings. Break the game with thousands of insane builds to become the King of Kings. With the Multiplayer Update, Kings of all stature can face off against each other in live multiplayer matches to see who really is the King of Kings. The 9 Kings Multiplayer update features cosmetics, leaderboards, and more. 9 Kings is available in Early Access on Xbox on PC, Steam, GOG, and Epic Games Store, and the Multiplayer Update is out now.
title: 9 Kings - Official Multiplayer Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Everything moves when you do in Enter the Chronosphere. Watch the Enter the Chronosphere early access launch trailer for this turn-based bullet hell roguelike. Each chronosphere is procedurally generated with defenders and biomes from the worlds it has consumed. Break in, find exotic weaponry and gadgets, outsmart hostile aliens, and fight your way to the core.

Enter the Chronosphere is available now in Steam Early Access.
title: Enter the Chronosphere - Official Early Access Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Demo launch trailer for Catnip Cosmos, a side-view shooter built around deep incremental progression. Shoot. Upgrade. Incrementally progress further. Pilot cat-operated spaceships on timed Zoomies runs, combine pilots for powerful synergies, defeat boss challenges to unlock new weapons, and improve exponentially. Catnip Cosmos is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Catnip Cosmos - Official Demo Launch Trailer
